description: Inspect the public record of one storefront order: line items, fulfillment, refunds, and event history. The customer's contact address is masked (`j••••@example.com`) and no payment identifiers are returned. Money amounts are integers in the currency's minor units (Stripe convention: 2500 = $25.00 USD, 1999 = ¥1999 JPY), paired with the order's currencyCode.
name: get_order
title: Get order
